categories.name: Commodity-backed Stablecoin
categories.content: A commodity-backed stablecoin is a type of stablecoin designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to a reserve of physical commodities such as gold.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Pump Science Ecosystem
categories.content: Pump Science Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pump.science.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Ansem.io Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens launched on ansem.io (https://ansem.io/).

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Gaming Marketplace
categories.content: A platform where players can buy, sell, or trade in-game assets, currencies, or digital items.

categories.name: Pump Fund Portfolio
categories.content: Projects and tokens officially backed by Pump Fund, the venture arm of Pump.fun. These projects are selected for their adherence to "build in public" principles, transparent development, and verified founder commitment.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: Ohm Fork
categories.content: An Ohm fork is a change to the underlying code of the Olympus DAO's OHM protocol that results in a split into a separate versions of the protocol.

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.

categories.name: Strategy Games
categories.content: Strategy game is a video game genre where players engage in planning, resource management, and decision-making to achieve specific objectives.

categories.name: Rebase Tokens
categories.content: Rebase tokens are cryptocurrencies that are usually pegged to a certain value, and they control their prices by algorithmically adjusting their token’s circulating supply.
